# Overview

This script builds every figure used in the job talk, except the sensitivity contour plot,
which needs the fitted models in `06a` and is saved to the same folder from there. All files
carry `_present` so they can always be told apart from the paper versions.

The H1, H2 and H3 click-throughs use the pre-period specification: sentiment z-scored within
outlet on pre-invasion means and standard deviations, then demeaned by pre-invasion topic
means on that scale, with no topic fixed effects. Pre-invasion values come from every
pre-invasion article in each hypothesis's sample. The raw-score versions go to the appendix.

Scatter points are daily means by publication day. Fit lines use probabilistic time.

**Inputs:**
- `data/intermediate/02_cleaned_data.rds`
- `data/intermediate/02_data_non_ukraine.rds`
- `data/intermediate/04_h1_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/05_h2_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/06_alignment_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/09_preperiod_results_prob.rds`
- `writing/presentations/kazahk_media_screenshot.png`
- `writing/presentations/invasion_photo.png`

**Outputs:**
- All figures in `figures/presentation/`
- `figures/presentation/figure_numbers.md` (counts and numbers quoted in the talk)

```{r setup-present, include=FALSE}
source("00_setup.R")
pacman::p_load(magick, ragg)

# Figures are written with ggsave() below; knitr's own copies stay out of the output folder
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(file.path(tempdir(), "12_present"), "/"))

set.seed(3184)
```

## Saving and the Numbers File

```{r save-helpers}
save_present <- function(plot, name, width_px, height_px) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_PRESENTATION, name), plot,
         width = width_px / 300, height = height_px / 300, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  cat("Saved:", name, "\n")
}

# Collected through the script and written to figure_numbers.md at the end
numbers_md <- character()
add_numbers <- function(...) numbers_md <<- c(numbers_md, ...)

md_table <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format(round(.x, digits), trim = TRUE,
                                                         big.mark = ",")))
  c(paste0("| ", paste(names(df), collapse = " | "), " |"),
    paste0("|", paste(rep("---", ncol(df)), collapse = "|"), "|"),
    apply(df, 1, function(r) paste0("| ", paste(r, collapse = " | "), " |")),
    "")
}

fmt_sd <- function(x) gsub("-", "−", sprintf("%+.2f SD", x))
```

## Discontinuity Plots

Every discontinuity figure goes through `plot_disc()`. Points are daily means by publication
day (`running`). Fit lines are article-level straight lines on `running_probabilistic`, one
per group on each side of the cutoff. Limits are passed in so that stages sharing a range
cannot jump between clicks.

```{r disc-helpers}
daily_means <- function(df, y, group_var = NULL) {
  df %>%
    mutate(.group = if (is.null(group_var)) factor("all") else .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    group_by(running, .group) %>%
    summarize(.y = mean(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE), num_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")
}

disc_limits <- function(df, y, group_var = NULL) {
  agg <- daily_means(df, y, group_var)
  list(x = range(agg$running), y = range(agg$.y), size = range(agg$num_obs))
}

plot_disc <- function(df, y, group_var = NULL, colors = c(all = pal$signalBlue),
                      lit = names(colors), fit_groups = lit, limits, y_lab,
                      jumps = NULL, corner_label = NULL, highlight = NULL, base_size = 12,
                      legend_inside = c(0.72, 0.97)) {
  single <- is.null(group_var)

  fit_data <- df %>%
    mutate(.group = if (single) factor("all") else .data[[group_var]], .y = .data[[y]]) %>%
    filter(.group %in% fit_groups)
  point_data <- daily_means(df, y, group_var) %>% filter(.group %in% lit)

  p <- ggplot(point_data, aes(x = running, y = .y, color = .group))

  # Shades the window the next stage zooms into
  if (!is.null(highlight)) {
    p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = -highlight, xmax = highlight, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                      fill = pal$mDarkTeal, alpha = 0.12)
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = pal$mLightBrown, linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(size = num_obs), alpha = 0.45, stroke = 0)

  if (length(fit_groups) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_smooth(data = fit_data,
                         aes(x = running_probabilistic, y = .y,
                             group = interaction(.group, treatment), color = .group),
                         method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, linewidth = 1, fill = "grey50",
                         alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  if (!is.null(jumps)) {
    p <- p + geom_label(data = jumps %>% filter(.group %in% fit_groups),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = fmt_sd(jump),
                            color = .group),
                        hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", linewidth = 0,
                        fill = alpha("white", 0.85), inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE)
  }

  if (!is.null(corner_label)) {
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = corner_label, hjust = 1.05,
                      vjust = 1.6, size = 3.2, color = "grey30")
  }

  p +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, limits = lit,
                       guide = if (single) "none" else
                         guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))) +
    scale_size(range = c(0.4, 4), limits = limits$size, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = limits$x, ylim = limits$y) +
    labs(x = LAB_X, y = y_lab, color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = legend_inside,
          legend.justification.inside = c(0, 1),
          legend.background = element_blank(), legend.key = element_blank())
}

# Size of the jump at the cutoff for each group, from the same lines the figure draws.
# With no fixed effects this is the group's own treatment coefficient.
jump_table <- function(df, y, group_var = NULL) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(.group = if (is.null(group_var)) factor("all") else .data[[group_var]])
  map_dfr(as.character(unique(df$.group)), function(g) {
    fit <- feols(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ running_probabilistic * treatment")),
                 cluster = ~source_domain,
                 data = droplevels(df[df$.group == g, ]), notes = FALSE)
    tibble(.group = g,
           pre  = unname(coef(fit)["(Intercept)"]),
           post = unname(coef(fit)["(Intercept)"] + coef(fit)["treatment"]),
           jump = unname(coef(fit)["treatment"]),
           se   = unname(se(fit)["treatment"]),
           p    = unname(pvalue(fit)["treatment"]),
           n    = nobs(fit),
           outlets = n_distinct(df$source_domain[df$.group == g]))
  })
}

# Raw-score translations of a window: share coded -1, article mean, mean of daily means
window_stats <- function(df, group_var = NULL) {
  df %>%
    mutate(.group = if (is.null(group_var)) "All outlets" else as.character(.data[[group_var]]),
           side = if_else(treatment == 1, "After", "Before")) %>%
    group_by(.group, side, running) %>%
    summarize(day_mean = mean(sentiment_clean), day_n = n(),
              day_neg = sum(sentiment_clean == -1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Group = .group, Side = side) %>%
    summarize(Articles = sum(day_n),
              `Share coded -1` = sum(day_neg) / sum(day_n),
              `Raw article mean` = weighted.mean(day_mean, day_n),
              `Raw daily mean` = mean(day_mean),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(Group, desc(Side))
}
```

# Load Data

`insajder.net` has no sentiment variance and leaves in the z-scoring step of every model, so
it is dropped here, which gives the 61 outlets the talk reports. The running variable is
rescaled from seconds to days, as in `05a` and `06a`.

```{r load-present}
results_h1   <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "04_h1_results_prob.rds"))
results_h2   <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "05_h2_results_prob.rds"))
results_h3   <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "06_alignment_results_prob.rds"))
results_prepd <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "09_preperiod_results_prob.rds"))

label_groups <- function(d) {
  d %>% mutate(
    media_type = factor(if_else(state_owned == 1, "State-owned", "Independent"),
                        levels = names(COLORS_OWNER)),
    treaty_group = factor(if_else(csto == 1, "Treaty client", "Non-treaty state"),
                          levels = names(COLORS_TREATY)),
    running_probabilistic = running_probabilistic / 86400
  )
}

# Following 05a, chunk `load-prob`
data_outlets <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "02_data_non_ukraine.rds")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(country, source_domain, topic_clean), as.factor)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  group_by(source_domain) %>%
  filter(sd(sentiment_clean, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  label_groups()

# Following 06a, chunks `load-prob` and `alignment-data-prob`
data_clean <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "02_cleaned_data.rds")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(country, source_domain, topic_clean), as.factor)) %>%
  label_groups()

cat("Analysis sample:", nrow(data_outlets), "articles,",
    nlevels(data_outlets$source_domain), "outlets\n")
cat("Articles where `treatment` and probabilistic time disagree on the side of the cutoff:",
    sum((data_outlets$running_probabilistic < 0) != (data_outlets$treatment == 0)), "\n")
```

# Maps

## Countries, Projection and Extent

Treaty clients have a mutual defense agreement with Russia. The two not in the corpus are on
the map because their UN votes are part of the puzzle. Group membership for the corpus
countries is checked against the project's own data.

Natural Earth draws Crimea as part of Russia. It is moved to Ukraine here.

```{r map-countries}
# un_vote is the March 2, 2022 General Assembly vote on A/ES-11/L.1, from the UN voting record
countries <- tribble(
  ~iso3, ~name,        ~treaty, ~un_vote,       ~group,      ~in_corpus,
  "ARM", "Armenia",    TRUE,    "abstained",    "treaty",    TRUE,
  "AZE", "Azerbaijan", TRUE,    "abstained",    "treaty",    TRUE,
  "BLR", "Belarus",    TRUE,    "against",      "treaty",    TRUE,
  "KAZ", "Kazakhstan", TRUE,    "abstained",    "treaty",    TRUE,
  "KGZ", "Kyrgyzstan", TRUE,    "abstained",    "treaty",    FALSE,
  "TJK", "Tajikistan", TRUE,    "abstained",    "treaty",    FALSE,
  "GEO", "Georgia",    FALSE,   "for",          "nontreaty", TRUE,
  "MDA", "Moldova",    FALSE,   "for",          "nontreaty", TRUE,
  "XKX", "Kosovo",     FALSE,   "not a member", "nontreaty", TRUE,
  "SRB", "Serbia",     FALSE,   "for",          "nontreaty", TRUE,
  "ALB", "Albania",    FALSE,   "for",          "nato",      TRUE,
  "HUN", "Hungary",    FALSE,   "for",          "nato",      TRUE,
  "TUR", "Turkey",     FALSE,   "for",          "nato",      TRUE
)

# The corpus countries and groups must agree with the project data
stopifnot(
  setequal(countries$name[countries$in_corpus], levels(data_outlets$country)),
  setequal(countries$name[countries$group == "treaty" & countries$in_corpus], CSTO_COUNTRIES),
  setequal(countries$name[countries$group == "nontreaty"], NEUTRAL_COUNTRIES),
  setequal(countries$name[countries$group == "nato"], setdiff(NATO_COUNTRIES, "Ukraine"))
)

CRS_MAP <- "+proj=laea +lat_0=50 +lon_0=55 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

world <- ne_countries(scale = 50, returnclass = "sf") %>%
  transmute(ne_code = adm0_a3) %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Crimea: move the Russia polygon inside this box over to Ukraine
crimea_box <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = 32, xmax = 36.8, ymin = 44, ymax = 46.3),
                                crs = st_crs(4326)))
russia_parts <- world %>% filter(ne_code == "RUS") %>% st_cast("POLYGON")
is_crimea <- as.vector(st_within(st_point_on_surface(russia_parts), crimea_box, sparse = FALSE))
cat("Russia polygons moved to Ukraine as Crimea:", sum(is_crimea), "\n")
crimea <- st_union(russia_parts[is_crimea, ])

world$geometry[world$ne_code == "RUS"] <- st_union(russia_parts[!is_crimea, ])
world$geometry[world$ne_code == "UKR"] <-
  st_union(st_union(world[world$ne_code == "UKR", ]), crimea)

# Everything drawn lies well inside this box, which also avoids reprojection artifacts
world_map <- world %>%
  st_crop(xmin = -25, xmax = 135, ymin = 12, ymax = 84) %>%
  st_transform(CRS_MAP)

countries <- countries %>% mutate(ne_code = if_else(iso3 == "XKX", "KOS", iso3))
map_sample <- world_map %>% inner_join(countries, by = "ne_code")
stopifnot(nrow(map_sample) == nrow(countries))

map_russia  <- world_map %>% filter(ne_code == "RUS")
map_ukraine <- world_map %>% filter(ne_code == "UKR")
map_other   <- world_map %>% filter(!ne_code %in% c(countries$ne_code, "RUS", "UKR"))

to_map_xy <- function(lon, lat) {
  st_coordinates(st_transform(st_sfc(map2(lon, lat, ~ st_point(c(.x, .y))), crs = 4326),
                              CRS_MAP))
}

# Frame: from just west of the sample to 95E, at 16:10, with room under the sample for the
# legend. Russia runs off the top: fitting its Arctic coast would shrink the sample countries
# into the bottom third of the map.
frame_box <- st_bbox(st_union(c(st_geometry(map_sample), st_geometry(map_ukraine))))
MAP_MARGIN <- 700000
frame_x <- c(frame_box[["xmin"]] - MAP_MARGIN, to_map_xy(95, 50)[, 1])
frame_height <- diff(frame_x) / 1.6
frame_y <- frame_box[["ymin"]] - 0.27 * frame_height + c(0, frame_height)
stopifnot(frame_box[["xmax"]] < frame_x[2], frame_box[["ymax"]] < frame_y[2])
cat("Map frame (km):", round(diff(frame_x) / 1000), "x", round(diff(frame_y) / 1000), "\n")
```

## Labels and Legend

Each label has a fixed position, so both maps match exactly at every stage. Countries too
small to hold their label get a leader line from their interior point.

```{r map-labels}
label_positions <- tribble(
  ~name,        ~lon, ~lat, ~leader,
  "Armenia",    49.8, 36.6, TRUE,
  "Azerbaijan", 53.5, 41.8, TRUE,
  "Belarus",    27.9, 53.7, FALSE,
  "Kazakhstan", 67.5, 48.3, FALSE,
  "Kyrgyzstan", 81.5, 39.5, TRUE,
  "Tajikistan", 69.5, 33.0, TRUE,
  "Georgia",    37.8, 42.9, TRUE,
  "Moldova",    30.0, 42.9, TRUE,
  "Kosovo",     13.2, 42.0, TRUE,
  "Serbia",     12.0, 45.0, TRUE,
  "Albania",    14.5, 39.8, TRUE,
  "Hungary",    12.0, 49.2, TRUE,
  "Turkey",     34.5, 38.9, FALSE
)

map_labels <- map_sample %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  mutate(anchor_x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
         anchor_y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(name, group, in_corpus, anchor_x, anchor_y) %>%
  left_join(label_positions, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(label_x = to_map_xy(lon, lat)[, 1],
         label_y = to_map_xy(lon, lat)[, 2])

context_labels <- tribble(
  ~name,     ~lon, ~lat,
  "Russia",  58.0, 55.8,
  "Ukraine", 33.0, 49.2
) %>%
  mutate(x = to_map_xy(lon, lat)[, 1], y = to_map_xy(lon, lat)[, 2])

MAP_LABEL_SIZE <- 10 / .pt

layer_map_labels <- function(label_color = "black") {
  labels <- map_labels %>%
    mutate(.color = if (is.function(label_color)) label_color(group, in_corpus) else label_color)
  list(
    geom_segment(data = labels %>% filter(leader),
                 aes(x = anchor_x, y = anchor_y, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
                 color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_label(data = labels, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = name, color = I(.color)),
               size = MAP_LABEL_SIZE, family = "sans", fill = "white", linewidth = 0,
               label.padding = unit(0.07, "lines"), inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )
}

layer_context_labels <- function() {
  geom_text(data = context_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = name),
            color = "#666666", fontface = "italic", size = MAP_LABEL_SIZE,
            family = "sans", inherit.aes = FALSE)
}

# Legend drawn in map coordinates: bottom left, inside the frame, grows downward
layer_map_legend <- function(items) {
  key_w <- 0.03 * diff(frame_x)
  row_h <- 0.057 * diff(frame_y)
  left  <- frame_x[1] + 0.012 * diff(frame_x)
  base  <- frame_y[1] + 0.02 * diff(frame_y)
  n     <- nrow(items)
  keys  <- items %>%
    mutate(row = row_number(),
           ymax = base + (n - row + 0.85) * row_h,
           ymin = base + (n - row + 0.15) * row_h,
           xmin = left, xmax = left + key_w)
  box_w <- max(nchar(items$label)) * 0.0118 * diff(frame_x) + key_w * 1.5

  hatch_rows <- keys %>% filter(hatch)
  hatch_layer <- if (nrow(hatch_rows) > 0) {
    hatch <- hatch_rows %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      reframe(x = xmin + c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8) * key_w, xend = x + 0.2 * key_w, y = ymin, yend = ymax)
    geom_segment(data = hatch, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
                 color = alpha(pal$treatyClient, 0.6), linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  list(
    annotate("rect", xmin = frame_x[1], xmax = left + box_w, ymin = frame_y[1],
             ymax = base + n * row_h + 0.01 * diff(frame_y), fill = "white", color = NA),
    geom_rect(data = keys, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = I(fill)),
              color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    hatch_layer,
    geom_text(data = keys, aes(x = xmax + 0.3 * key_w, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = label),
              hjust = 0, size = MAP_LABEL_SIZE, family = "sans", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )
}

map_coord_theme <- function() {
  list(
    coord_sf(crs = st_crs(CRS_MAP), xlim = frame_x, ylim = frame_y, expand = FALSE, datum = NA),
    theme_void(base_family = "sans"),
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  )
}

MAP_BORDER <- 0.3
```

## Figure 1: UN Vote Map

```{r fig-un-vote-map, fig.width=5.33, fig.height=3.33}
# Azerbaijan did not cast a vote and is grouped with the abstentions. Kosovo is not a UN member,
# so it has no vote to show.
VOTE_FILL <- c("against" = pal$voteAgainst, "abstained" = pal$voteAbstained,
               "for" = alpha(pal$nonTreaty, 0.6), "not a member" = alpha(pal$nonTreaty, 0.2))

vote_map_fill <- map_sample %>%
  mutate(.fill = unname(VOTE_FILL[un_vote]))

un_vote_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = map_other, fill = "#F5F5F5", color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
  geom_sf(data = map_russia, fill = "#DDDDDD", color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
  geom_sf(data = vote_map_fill, aes(fill = I(.fill)), color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
  geom_sf(data = map_ukraine, fill = NA, color = pal$mDarkTeal, linewidth = 0.6) +
  layer_map_labels() +
  layer_context_labels() +
  layer_map_legend(tibble(
    label = c("Voted against", "Abstained", "In sample, voted for",
              "In sample, not a UN member"),
    fill  = unname(VOTE_FILL[c("against", "abstained", "for", "not a member")]),
    hatch = FALSE
  )) +
  map_coord_theme()

save_present(un_vote_map, "un_vote_map_present.png", 1600, 1000)
un_vote_map
```

## Figure 4: Sample Map

The first stage has no color. After that, one group lights up per click and stays lit. Unlit
sample countries are drawn pale with a grey label, so the room sees where the next group will
appear. Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are hatched only while the treaty clients are introduced.

```{r fig-sample-map, fig.width=5.33, fig.height=3.33}
# 45-degree lines clipped to the two treaty clients outside the corpus
not_in_corpus <- map_sample %>% filter(!in_corpus)
hatch_box <- st_bbox(not_in_corpus)
hatch_step <- 45000
hatch_offsets <- seq(hatch_box[["xmin"]] - (hatch_box[["ymax"]] - hatch_box[["ymin"]]),
                     hatch_box[["xmax"]], by = hatch_step)
hatch_lines <- st_sfc(
  lapply(hatch_offsets, function(x0) {
    st_linestring(rbind(c(x0, hatch_box[["ymin"]]),
                        c(x0 + hatch_box[["ymax"]] - hatch_box[["ymin"]], hatch_box[["ymax"]])))
  }),
  crs = st_crs(map_sample)
)
hatch_clipped <- st_intersection(hatch_lines, st_union(not_in_corpus))

GROUP_FILL <- c(treaty = pal$treatyClient,
                nontreaty = alpha(pal$nonTreaty, 0.6),
                nato = alpha(pal$indepMedia, 0.45))
SAMPLE_LEGEND <- tibble(
  label = c("Treaty client", "Treaty client, not in corpus", "Non-treaty state", "NATO member"),
  fill  = c(GROUP_FILL[["treaty"]], "white", GROUP_FILL[["nontreaty"]], GROUP_FILL[["nato"]]),
  hatch = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
)

# The small "not in corpus" notes sit under each country's label
not_in_corpus_notes <- map_labels %>%
  filter(!in_corpus) %>%
  mutate(y = label_y - 0.038 * diff(frame_y))

build_sample_map <- function(lit_groups, legend_rows, show_not_in_corpus = FALSE) {
  fills <- map_sample %>%
    mutate(.fill = case_when(
      !group %in% lit_groups ~ "#F5F5F5",
      !in_corpus             ~ "#F5F5F5",
      TRUE                   ~ unname(GROUP_FILL[group])
    ))

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = map_other, fill = "#F5F5F5", color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
    geom_sf(data = map_russia, fill = "#DDDDDD", color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
    geom_sf(data = fills, aes(fill = I(.fill)), color = pal$dimgray, linewidth = MAP_BORDER) +
    (if (show_not_in_corpus) {
      geom_sf(data = st_sf(geometry = hatch_clipped), color = alpha(pal$treatyClient, 0.4),
              linewidth = 0.3)
    }) +
    geom_sf(data = map_ukraine, fill = NA, color = pal$mDarkTeal, linewidth = 0.6) +
    layer_map_labels(function(g, corpus) {
      if_else(g %in% lit_groups & (corpus | show_not_in_corpus), "black", pal$dimgray)
    }) +
    layer_context_labels() +
    (if (show_not_in_corpus) {
      geom_text(data = not_in_corpus_notes, aes(x = label_x, y = y), label = "not in corpus",
                fontface = "italic", size = 7 / .pt, family = "sans", inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }) +
    (if (length(legend_rows) > 0) layer_map_legend(SAMPLE_LEGEND[legend_rows, ])) +
    map_coord_theme()
}

sample_map_stages <- list(
  list(file = "sample_map_s1_present.png", lit = character(0), rows = integer(0), hatch = FALSE),
  list(file = "sample_map_s2_present.png", lit = "treaty", rows = 1:2, hatch = TRUE),
  list(file = "sample_map_s3_present.png", lit = c("treaty", "nontreaty"), rows = c(1, 3),
       hatch = FALSE),
  list(file = "sample_map_s4_present.png", lit = c("treaty", "nontreaty", "nato"),
       rows = c(1, 3, 4), hatch = FALSE)
)

for (stage in sample_map_stages) {
  save_present(build_sample_map(stage$lit, stage$rows, stage$hatch), stage$file, 1600, 1000)
}
```

```{r fig-sample-bars, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.67}
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"))
}
```

# Main Results: Pre-Period Specification

## Building the Outcome

`sentiment_z_pre_tdm` follows spec 4 of `09_preperiod_diagnostics.Rmd`, with one deliberate
difference. Spec 4 calculates pre-invasion values from the matched rows inside the bandwidth.
Here they come from every pre-invasion article in the hypothesis's full-range sample, so one
fixed baseline applies to every point across all stages. Outlets with no pre-invasion
articles, or no pre-invasion variance, cannot be standardized and are dropped and listed.

```{r pre-period-outcome}
add_pre_period_outcome <- function(d, label) {
  pre <- d %>% filter(running_probabilistic < 0)

  source_moments <- pre %>%
    group_by(source_domain) %>%
    summarize(pre_mean = mean(sentiment_clean), pre_sd = sd(sentiment_clean),
              n_pre = n(), .groups = "drop")
  keep <- source_moments %>% filter(!is.na(pre_sd), pre_sd > 0)

  dropped <- d %>%
    filter(!source_domain %in% keep$source_domain) %>%
    count(source_domain, country, name = "articles") %>%
    mutate(sample = label, source_domain = as.character(source_domain),
           country = as.character(country))

  out <- d %>%
    inner_join(keep, by = "source_domain") %>%
    mutate(sentiment_z_pre = (sentiment_clean - pre_mean) / pre_sd)

  topic_means <- out %>%
    filter(running_probabilistic < 0) %>%
    group_by(topic_clean) %>%
    summarize(pre_topic_mean = mean(sentiment_z_pre), .groups = "drop")

  out <- out %>%
    left_join(topic_means, by = "topic_clean") %>%
    mutate(sentiment_z_pre_tdm = sentiment_z_pre - pre_topic_mean) %>%
    droplevels()

  list(data = out, dropped = dropped)
}
```

## H1 Sample

Non-military articles from all countries, unmatched. The window is held at Table 1 Model 6's
bandwidth, as S15 holds each main model's bandwidth fixed.

```{r h1-sample}
h1_full <- data_outlets %>%
  filter(topic_clean != "Military") %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number())
h1_built <- add_pre_period_outcome(h1_full, "H1")

# Hold both of Model 6's bandwidths: h for the estimate, b for the bias correction
H1_WINDOW <- results_h1$model6a_nonmil$bws[1, 1] / 86400
H1_BIAS_BW <- results_h1$model6a_nonmil$bws[2, 1] / 86400
cat("H1 window:", round(H1_WINDOW, 2), "days\n")

h1_data <- h1_built$data
h1_window_data <- h1_data %>% filter(abs(running_probabilistic) < H1_WINDOW)

h1_model <- rdrobust(y = h1_data$sentiment_z_pre_tdm, x = h1_data$running_probabilistic,
                     h = H1_WINDOW, b = H1_BIAS_BW, cluster = h1_data$source_domain)
summary(h1_model)
```

## H2 Sample and Matched Rows

Non-NATO, non-military. The matched rows are rebuilt exactly as in `05a`, and must reproduce
Table 2 Model 6 before they are used.

```{r h2-sample}
BW_H2 <- results_prepd$matched_bandwidths$h2

h2_full <- data_outlets %>%
  filter(topic_clean != "Military") %>%
  group_by(source_domain) %>%
  mutate(sentiment_z = (sentiment_clean - mean(sentiment_clean)) / sd(sentiment_clean)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!country %in% NATO_COUNTRIES) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number())

h2_matching_frame <- h2_full %>%
  filter(running_probabilistic < BW_H2, running_probabilistic > -BW_H2) %>%
  droplevels()
h2_matched_rows <- match.data(matchit(state_owned ~ running + topic_clean,
                                      data = h2_matching_frame, method = "exact", ratio = 1))

h2_main_check <- feols(sentiment_z ~ running_probabilistic * treatment * state_owned | topic_clean,
                       cluster = ~source_domain, data = h2_matched_rows)
stopifnot(all.equal(unname(coef(h2_main_check)["treatment:state_owned"]),
                    unname(coef(results_h2$matched_model_z)["treatment:state_owned"]),
                    tolerance = 1e-8))

h2_built <- add_pre_period_outcome(h2_full, "H2")
h2_data <- h2_built$data
h2_window_data <- h2_data %>% filter(.row_id %in% h2_matched_rows$.row_id) %>% droplevels()

h2_model <- feols(sentiment_z_pre_tdm ~ running_probabilistic * treatment * state_owned,
                  cluster = ~source_domain, data = h2_window_data)
summary(h2_model)
h2_boot <- run_wild_bootstrap(h2_model, "treatment:state_owned")
```

## H3 Sample and Matched Rows

State media in non-NATO countries, non-military. The matched rows are rebuilt as in `06a`,
and must reproduce Table 4 Model 5 before they are used.

```{r h3-sample}
BW_H3 <- results_prepd$matched_bandwidths$h3a

h3_full <- data_clean %>%
  filter(nato == 0) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(state_owned == 1, topic_clean != "Military") %>%
  group_by(source_domain) %>%
  mutate(sentiment_z = (sentiment_clean - mean(sentiment_clean)) / sd(sentiment_clean)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number())

h3_matching_frame <- h3_full %>%
  filter(running_probabilistic < BW_H3, running_probabilistic > -BW_H3)
h3_matched_rows <- match.data(matchit(csto ~ running + topic_clean,
                                      data = h3_matching_frame, method = "exact", ratio = 1))

h3_main_check <- feols(sentiment_z ~ running_probabilistic * treatment * csto | topic_clean,
                       cluster = ~source_domain, data = h3_matched_rows)
stopifnot(all.equal(unname(coef(h3_main_check)["treatment:csto"]),
                    unname(coef(results_h3$matched_model)["treatment:csto"]),
                    tolerance = 1e-8))

h3_built <- add_pre_period_outcome(h3_full, "H3")
h3_data <- h3_built$data
h3_window_data <- h3_data %>% filter(.row_id %in% h3_matched_rows$.row_id) %>% droplevels()

h3_model <- feols(sentiment_z_pre_tdm ~ running_probabilistic * treatment * csto,
                  cluster = ~source_domain, data = h3_window_data)
summary(h3_model)
h3_boot <- run_wild_bootstrap(h3_model, "treatment:csto")
```

## Stages Shared by H2 and H3

Eight stages, with `lit` giving the order the two groups appear in: the first group's dots, both
groups' dots, the first group's line, the second group's line, the window shaded, then dots and
each line again inside the window.

```{r stage-helper}
save_group_stages <- function(prefix, df, window_df, group_var, colors, lit, window_days,
                              limits, limits_window, jumps) {
  save_stage <- function(n, data, stage_limits, ...) {
    save_present(plot_disc(data, "sentiment_z_pre_tdm", group_var, colors,
                           limits = stage_limits, y_lab = LAB_Y_SD, ...),
                 sprintf("%s_s%d_present.png", prefix, n), DISC_WIDTH_PX, DISC_HEIGHT_PX)
  }

  save_stage(1, df, limits, lit = lit[1], fit_groups = character(0))
  save_stage(2, df, limits, lit = lit, fit_groups = character(0))
  save_stage(3, df, limits, lit = lit, fit_groups = lit[1])
  save_stage(4, df, limits, lit = lit)
  save_stage(5, df, limits, lit = lit, highlight = window_days)
  save_stage(6, window_df, limits_window, lit = lit, fit_groups = character(0))
  save_stage(7, window_df, limits_window, lit = lit, fit_groups = lit[1], jumps = jumps)
  save_stage(8, window_df, limits_window, lit = lit, jumps = jumps)
}
```

# Appendix: Lowess Version of `h3_s4`

Same sample, outcome, points and axes as `h3_s4`, with a smoother in place of the straight lines.
The smoother is local linear with tricube weights and a span of 2/3, fitted to articles separately
for each group on each side of the cutoff. It leaves out the robustness step in `lowess()`'s
default: that step downweights points far from the line, and because sentiment takes few distinct
values, it pulls the curve toward the most common value and nearly erases the drop.

`loess()` with `family = "gaussian"` is used because it matches `lowess(iter = 0)` and also gives
standard errors. The bands are pointwise 95% and not clustered.

```{r fig-appendix-lowess, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
LOWESS_SPAN <- 2 / 3
LOWESS_GRID <- 200

lowess_side <- function(df, y) {
  fit <- loess(as.formula(paste(y, "~ running_probabilistic")), data = df, span = LOWESS_SPAN,
               degree = 1, family = "gaussian", control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  # The grid runs to the cutoff itself, so the two sides of each group can be compared there
  ends <- if (df$treatment[1] == 1) c(0, max(df$running_probabilistic)) else
    c(min(df$running_probabilistic), 0)
  grid <- tibble(running_probabilistic = seq(ends[1], ends[2], length.out = LOWESS_GRID))
  pred <- predict(fit, grid, se = TRUE)
  grid %>% mutate(fit = pred$fit, lower = fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit, upper = fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
}

h3_lowess <- h3_data %>%
  group_by(.group = treaty_group, treatment) %>%
  group_modify(~ lowess_side(.x %>% mutate(treatment = .y$treatment), "sentiment_z_pre_tdm")) %>%
  ungroup()

h3_lowess_plot <- plot_disc(h3_data, "sentiment_z_pre_tdm", "treaty_group", COLORS_TREATY,
                            lit = c("Non-treaty state", "Treaty client"),
                            fit_groups = character(0), limits = h3_limits, y_lab = LAB_Y_SD) +
  geom_ribbon(data = h3_lowess,
              aes(x = running_probabilistic, ymin = lower, ymax = upper,
                  group = interaction(.group, treatment)),
              fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = h3_lowess,
            aes(x = running_probabilistic, y = fit, color = .group,
                group = interaction(.group, treatment)),
            linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE)

save_present(h3_lowess_plot, "h3_s4_lowess_present.png", DISC_WIDTH_PX, DISC_HEIGHT_PX)

# Jumps at the cutoff beside the straight lines of h3_s4
h3_lowess_jumps <- h3_lowess %>%
  filter(running_probabilistic == 0) %>%
  transmute(Group = as.character(.group), side = if_else(treatment == 1, "After", "Before"), fit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side, values_from = fit) %>%
  mutate(`Lowess jump` = After - Before) %>%
  left_join(jump_table(h3_data, "sentiment_z_pre_tdm", "treaty_group") %>%
              transmute(Group = .group, `Straight-line jump` = jump),
            by = "Group") %>%
  select(Group, Before, After, `Lowess jump`, `Straight-line jump`)
print(as.data.frame(h3_lowess_jumps))

add_numbers(
  "### Appendix: Lowess Version of `h3_s4`", "",
  "Non-robust, span 2/3, full range. Values at the cutoff in within-outlet SD.", "",
  md_table(h3_lowess_jumps)
)
```

## Figure 10: Pre-Trends by Treaty Client

Same four panels and date markers as the paper's `pretrend_by_country_aligned.png`. As in the
paper version, the fit is on the pre-invasion daily means.

```{r fig-pretrend, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
PRETREND_START <- as.Date("2021-06-01")
PRETREND_END   <- as.Date("2022-06-01")
WARNING_DATE   <- as.Date("2021-12-07")

agg_pretrend <- data_clean %>%
  filter(country %in% CSTO_COUNTRIES, state_owned == 1,
         date_publish >= PRETREND_START, date_publish <= PRETREND_END) %>%
  mutate(country = droplevels(country)) %>%
  group_by(country, date_publish) %>%
  summarize(sentiment_clean = mean(sentiment_clean, na.rm = TRUE),
            num_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")

pretrend_treaty <- ggplot(agg_pretrend, aes(x = date_publish, y = sentiment_clean)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = num_obs), alpha = 0.25, color = pal$treatyClient) +
  geom_smooth(data = agg_pretrend %>% filter(date_publish < INVASION_DATE),
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = pal$treatyClient,
              fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = INVASION_DATE, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = WARNING_DATE, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") +
  scale_size(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ country, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = "Publication date", y = "Mean sentiment toward Russia")

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_PRESENTATION, "pretrend_by_country_treaty_present.png"),
       pretrend_treaty, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Figure 11: Non-Treaty Floor

Same two panels as `05b`'s floor figure. Panel A's fit lines use probabilistic time, placed on
the date axis.

```{r fig-floor, fig.width=13, fig.height=6.5}
SENTIMENT_FLOOR <- -1
COLORS_FLOOR_TREATY <- c("State-owned" = pal$nonTreatyText, "Independent" = pal$indepMedia)
LABELS_FLOOR_TREATY <- c("State-owned" = "Non-treaty state media",
                         "Independent" = "Non-treaty independent media")

data_floor <- data_outlets %>%
  filter(csto == 0, nato == 0) %>%
  mutate(media_floor = factor(as.character(media_type), levels = c("State-owned", "Independent")),
         period = factor(if_else(treatment == 1, "Post-invasion", "Pre-invasion"),
                         levels = c("Pre-invasion", "Post-invasion")),
         date_probabilistic = INVASION_DATE + running_probabilistic)

agg_floor_daily <- data_floor %>%
  group_by(media_floor, date_publish) %>%
  summarize(sentiment_clean = mean(sentiment_clean), num_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")

agg_floor_period <- data_floor %>%
  group_by(media_floor, period) %>%
  summarize(mean_sentiment = mean(sentiment_clean),
            se = sd(sentiment_clean) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ci_lower = mean_sentiment - 1.96 * se, ci_upper = mean_sentiment + 1.96 * se)

agg_floor_change <- agg_floor_period %>%
  select(media_floor, period, mean_sentiment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = mean_sentiment) %>%
  mutate(change = `Post-invasion` - `Pre-invasion`)

panel_floor_scale <- ggplot(agg_floor_daily,
                            aes(x = date_publish, y = sentiment_clean, color = media_floor)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = num_obs), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = SENTIMENT_FLOOR, color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = min(agg_floor_daily$date_publish), y = SENTIMENT_FLOOR + 0.08,
           label = "Scale floor (−1)", hjust = 0, size = 5, color = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = INVASION_DATE, linetype = "dashed", color = pal$mLightBrown) +
  geom_smooth(data = data_floor,
              aes(x = date_probabilistic, y = sentiment_clean,
                  group = interaction(media_floor, period), color = media_floor),
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, linewidth = 1.2, fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = COLORS_FLOOR_TREATY, labels = LABELS_FLOOR_TREATY, name = NULL) +
  scale_size(guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 4, fill = NA))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.26, 0.92),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15), legend.background = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "A. Full scale", x = "Publication date", y = "Mean sentiment toward Russia")

panel_floor_detail <- ggplot(agg_floor_period,
                             aes(x = period, y = mean_sentiment,
                                 color = media_floor, group = media_floor)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_sentiment),
                hjust = if_else(period == "Pre-invasion", 1.3, -0.3)),
            size = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = agg_floor_change,
             aes(x = 1.5, y = (`Pre-invasion` + `Post-invasion`) / 2,
                 label = sprintf("%+.3f", change), color = media_floor),
             size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", fill = "white", linewidth = 0,
             label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = COLORS_FLOOR_TREATY, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.3)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  labs(title = "B. Pre/post means", x = NULL, y = NULL)

nontreaty_floor <- (panel_floor_scale | panel_floor_detail) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_PRESENTATION, "nontreaty_floor_present.png"),
       nontreaty_floor, width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Screenshot and Photograph

## Figure 2: Kazakhstanskaya Pravda

Two crops of the Google-translated page, stacked to remove the navigation bar, currency
ticker and broker ad, then upscaled to the 1600 px the slide expects.

```{r fig-screenshot}
screenshot <- image_read(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "writing", "presentations",
                                   "kazahk_media_screenshot.png")) %>%
  image_background("white", flatten = TRUE)

masthead <- image_crop(screenshot, "570x70+165+15")
headline <- image_crop(screenshot, "1240x265+80+465")

screenshot_stacked <- image_blank(1240, 70 + 20 + 265, color = "white") %>%
  image_composite(masthead, offset = "+0+0") %>%
  image_composite(headline, offset = "+0+90") %>%
  image_resize("1600x", filter = "Lanczos")

image_write(screenshot_stacked, file.path(FIGURES_PRESENTATION, "kazahk_media_screenshot_present.png"))
```
